authority: PI directive, feasibility verified before freezing, eval-set choice ratified
classification: SCORER-ONLY ABLATION. No PPO training. No new PPO seeds. SPPPO V1 remains CLOSED.
the_question: Does own_flag_stolen ranking correctness recover as the ABSOLUTE number of stolen-flag branch pairs increases, holding architecture/target/loss/data-family fixed? Distinguishes absolute-density-limited from representation/capacity-limited.

CORRECTION_BEFORE_FREEZING.what: the working figure of ~91 stolen branch pairs was the FULL 256-seed count from D1A (train+held-out combined)
CORRECTION_BEFORE_FREEZING.the_real_baseline: the 128 INNER_FIT seeds Q_psi was ACTUALLY fit on contain only 50 stolen branch pairs on pole B (out of 384 total pole-B branch pairs)

density_ladder.design: NESTED, not independently sampled -- rung_2's extra 50 pairs are a strict subset of rung_3's extra 150, so rung_3's data is a superset of rung_2's, which is a superset of rung_1's. Isolates density as the only variable across rungs.
density_ladder.source_pool: 3,529 stolen-flag decision points available across 71 of the 128 INNER_FIT seeds -- verified before freezing, zero new seeds required

point_selection.procedure: frozen RNG draw, capped per seed, from the 3,529-point pool
point_selection.cap_rationale: prevents the density increase from being secretly 'a few seeds supply all the new signal' -- an increase in seed-diversity of evidence, not just point-count, confounded with density

collection_mechanism.reuses_unchanged: the exact replay-to-state + branch-both-teachers procedure from phase0_collect_scorer_data.branch_at() -- same frozen SAPPO teachers, same continuation semantics (teacher-consistent), same env construction
collection_mechanism.output: supplement branch shards, stored separately from the original Phase 0 shards, merged only at load time
collection_mechanism.no_seed_audit_needed: all seeds are already-audited INNER_FIT train seeds; no new seed enters the corpus

reuses_unchanged: QPsi architecture (n_regimes=1, the ORIGINAL frozen form)
weighted MSE loss (plain rows 1/episode_len, branch rows 1.0)
Adam lr=3e-4, batch_size=512, max_epochs=60, early_stop_patience=8, torch_seed=7
refit_procedure.only_change: the branch-row set fed into fitting, per rung
refit_procedure.rung_1_is_a_FRESH_refit_not_the_original: comparing the ORIGINAL frozen checkpoint against NEW refits at higher density would confound density with run-to-run noise -- SPPPO's own production run showed CUDA nondeterminism between nominally identical runs. All three rungs are fresh refits under identical infrastructure; only the data differs.
refit_procedure.one_fit_per_rung: exactly one fitting run per rung, frozen before comparison, no re-tries, no cherry-picking
refit_procedure.n_regimes_4_scaffold: explicitly NOT used. This ablation tests the ORIGINAL architecture's data-density sensitivity, not a new architecture.

evaluation.set: INNER_VAL (32 seeds), restricted to its own_flag_stolen subset: 1,147 decision points across 17 seeds
evaluation.PI_ratified: reuse INNER_VAL for this second diagnostic purpose -- Gate 0B's 96 held-out seeds are permanently spent and excluded; INNER_VAL was never a one-shot confirmatory resource, only Phase 0's non-gate train-side calibration set
evaluation.classification: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. NOT a new Gate 0B. NOT independent confirmation of anything.
evaluation.metric: Q_psi correct-rate: fraction of INNER_VAL stolen-flag decision points where V_hat(o,z1,B) - V_hat(o,z0,B) > 0.04 (the frozen SPPPO margin), per rung

bootstrap.note: same convention as Gate 0B / D0 / D1

PERMITTED_READING.recovers_substantially: correct-rate rises from ~0.24 (D0 finding) substantially toward the 0.80+ range seen in other categories -> absolute sample density was the dominant scorer problem; a successor should include targeted counterfactual collection for rare/high-stakes regimes
PERMITTED_READING.stays_inverted: correct-rate remains near or below chance despite 4x the data -> representation/target/capacity problem; more data is not the fix; a regime-conditioned scorer or richer target becomes justified
prohibited: declaring a successor architecture from D2 alone
using D2's refit scorers for anything beyond this ablation
extending the ladder beyond rung 3 after seeing rung 3's result
reusing INNER_VAL a third time for any future diagnostic without a fresh PI ruling

sequencing: D2 only. Optimization interference (the second known problem) is explicitly deferred -- not mixed into this experiment.
